title: The $7 Daily Habit Costing You A Luxury Car
hook_text: THAT $7 HABIT COSTS A LUXURY CAR

beats.say: That $7 daily takeout coffee is actually costing you a luxury car by the time you retire.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of a steaming paper cup on a wet, rain-slick concrete curb under cold fluorescent light.

beats.say: Here is the exact compound math behind every single morning purchase you make.
beats.visual: Low angle shot of a solitary pedestrian silhouette crossing an empty highway at night under sodium streetlamps.

beats.say: Most people assume spending $7 a day just means skipping a small treat.
beats.visual: High angle shot of a dark, rain-slick intersection with single practical streetlights cutting through thick fog.

beats.say: They figure it is only $210 a month leaving their checking account.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a massive suspension bridge tower edge disappearing into heavy blue hour mist.

beats.say: But where does that money actually go over a standard career?
beats.visual: Silhouetted hands holding a blank card against a dark background lit by a single cold fluorescent tube.

beats.say: Invested at an 8% annual return over 30 years, that routine grows.
beats.visual: Low angle shot of towering concrete highway overpasses cutting across a dark, rain-soaked landscape.

beats.say: It does not just add up to $75,000 in raw cash.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of dark water rippling under cold, sodium-lit dock pilings at night.

beats.say: It turns into $310,000 of lost investment capital by retirement day.
beats.visual: Silhouettes of commuters walking past a massive concrete wall under harsh fluorescent station lights.

beats.say: That tiny daily convenience trades your future freedom for instant morning comfort.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of an empty asphalt highway stretching toward a dark, fog-covered mountain ridge.

beats.say: You can keep buying the habit, or redirect the cash into your own accounts.
beats.visual: Single practical light casting a long shadow across a wet concrete loading dock at blue hour.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of dark rain hitting a cold metal rail under a single sodium light.

caption: That daily habit is quietly stealing your retirement capital. #money #personalfinance #investing #wealth #retirement
description: Breaking down how small daily convenience purchases compound into hundreds of thousands in lost investment capital over a working career.
first_comment: What is one daily habit you would trade for a six-figure portfolio?

facts.claim: $210 a month invested at 8% over 30 years grows to over $310,000
facts.basis: Standard compound interest formula: PMT 210, rate 8%, periods 360 months
